description: Record where one input value came from, so anyone can check it. Only for a value you, or the user, took from that source. A project file is cited with the [[source:…]] token read_project_file or search_project_files gives: a quote must be the exact words in the file, and is refused otherwise. A web page needs its url and title. One value in one scenario per call, or many in one: items, each with these same fields.

accessed_on.description: When the page was read, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

cite.description: A project file: [[source:<path>|p=<page>|q=<exact words>]], |sheet=…|range=… for a spreadsheet, or just the path for the whole file.

items.description: Many sources in one write, each {component, attribute, …}.

note.description: How the value follows, e.g. "converted from $/kW".

quote.description: The words on the web page that give the value.

scenario.description: Scenario name. Absent or "base": the base network, whose source also backs a scenario that keeps the base value.

name: add_source
